title: Banana Taffy Freeze Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
description:
Banana Taffy Freeze Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
Indulge in a Burst of Flavor
The Banana Taffy Freeze Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 is your ticket to a vaping experience like no other. With every puff, indulge in the creamy sweetness of ripe bananas paired with the cool, refreshing sensation of icy taffy. It’s a perfectly balanced fusion of fruity decadence and frosty satisfaction that you’ll crave again and again.
High-Quality, Hassle-Free Experience
Designed as a premium disposable vape, the Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 delivers unmatched convenience without compromising on quality. No refills, no recharging—just pure, uninterrupted vaping enjoyment. With its sleek, compact design, it’s easy to carry in your pocket or bag, ensuring you always have it within reach.
Long-Lasting Performance
The Pulse X 25000 is built for endurance, offering up to 25,000 puffs of delightful flavor. Whether you’re a seasoned vaper or exploring the world of vaping for the first time, this high-capacity device is engineered to keep up with your lifestyle, offering consistent performance and flavor from the first puff to the last.
Key Features
Puff Count
:
Up to 25,000 (Regular Mode) or 15,000 (Pulse Mode)
E-liquid
:
18mL, 5% nicotine
Battery
: 820mAh rechargeable (USB-C)
Display
: Smart 3D Curved LED Screen
Coils
: Dual Mesh for superior flavor
Modes
: Soft, Normal, Pulse
Airflow
: Adjustable for customized draw
Elevate Your Vaping Game
Step into a world where flavor, convenience, and performance intersect. The Banana Taffy Freeze Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 isn’t just a vape; it’s a statement. Satisfy your taste buds and enjoy a seamless, effortless vaping experience today!
